causal_read.conclusion: The autonomous candidate errors are too collinear for output-space stacking to create a material accuracy gain.
evidence: The best outer-fold-held convex stack improves J by only 0.365 percent and remains above the 3.107e-8 gate.
The typed-variance I candidate receives zero final-layer convex weight in every outer calibration fold.
The same-row unrestricted global span reaches only 3.21857e-8, while even 5,120 separately fit same-row per-unit coefficients reach only 3.17960e-8.
The worst OOF network remains rank 643 near 3.39e-7, so averaging does not remove the shared hard-row failure.
causal_read.interpretation: The limiting error is shared autonomous-state bias rather than independent candidate noise. A route toward 1e-8 needs new orthogonal state information or a changed autonomous transition, not another linear blend of D/J/I/K/M outputs.

no_successor.reason: The bounded family missed the material gate, the gain was below 5 percent, and its optimistic same-row span ceiling is also far above 1e-8; further coefficient or subset sweeps are not justified.
